pages.text: $(l)Ender IO$() is a compact tech mod best known for its $(l)conduits$(): power, items, fluids and redstone all run through one block instead of four parallel pipe runs.$(br2)Its machines run on a ladder of alloys made in the Alloy Smelter, which is why they need pinning.

$(l)Tier 3$(): redstone alloy 8 FU, copper alloy 12, conductive alloy 18.$(br2)$(l)Tier 4$(): pulsating alloy and soularium 30, energetic alloy 35, dark steel 40.$(br2)$(l)Tier 5$(): vibrant alloy at 55.$(br2)$(l)Tier 6$(): end steel at 90.
